summary: A user met someone on Tinder who quickly pressured them to begin options trading on a website called mewswap.vip and became emotional when they refused. The platform was presented as an investment opportunity tied to the relationship and is described as a likely fake trading site.
user_mistake: considering depositing funds into a trading site promoted by an online romantic contact
prevention: Refuse investment opportunities introduced by dating app contacts and independently verify any trading platform before depositing funds
